reason: I merged three AI-written PRs this week and only trusted them because CI was green, and the one-cent invoice bug that got past passing tests is exactly the kind of thing that scares me. It's free and a single command, so I'll install it on a weekend and point it at the old app.
objection: My tests already catch regressions, and I doubt recording and replaying an old Windows app in some sandbox really works in a minute rather than an afternoon of setup and false diffs.
would_change_my_mind: If the first run on my own app buries me in noisy diffs or the Windows sandbox doesn't boot cleanly, I uninstall it and go back to trusting my tests.
